recorded.pass:q-pcode-key:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-pcode-key:b: 13.2's output shows the purchase key with no field 11, so the override's fields are not added to the default.
recorded.prompt:q-pcode-key:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-pcode-key:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)

recorded.prompt:q-reverse-commit:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reverse-commit:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-reverse-commit:a: 13.3's two runs (0210 39=00, then no answer) show that the commit order changes what is sent.
recorded.prompt:q-reverse-commit:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reverse-commit:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-reverse-commit:b: 13.3 says SendResponse sent nothing while TX was set; it does not wait.

recorded.pass:q-reverse-commit:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)

recorded.pass:q-dead-link:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)

recorded.pass:q-thread-local:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
